extensions.platform: android (Jetpack Compose, Material 3); dark-only by decision; dimensions dp and type sp, written as px

headline.purpose: Library title, empty-library title, seek-readout delta (tabular).

headline-small.purpose: Video title on the setup sheet.

title.purpose: Sheet headings and the playback-error title.

title-medium.purpose: Library row titles, player top-bar title, loaded subtitle language names.

title-small.purpose: Label of the primary Play / Resume pill.

body-large.purpose: Settings rows, empty-state body, placeholder slot names.

body.purpose: Helper copy, error body, hint pill, timing offset (tabular).

label.purpose: Buttons, scrubber times, speed readout (tabular), sentence-case section label.

index-tab.purpose: Two-letter language codes on edge tabs and the language switch; 18px at >=840dp, 11px on slot marks.

subtitle.purpose: Caption text over the picture; 19px under 600dp, 24px to 1000dp, 30px above; white with black stroke.

shadows.name: subtitle-outline
shadows.purpose: Subtitle text only, for legibility over any footage. Surfaces carry no shadows.

shadows.name: scrim-top
shadows.purpose: Behind the player top bar while controls show.

shadows.name: scrim-bottom
shadows.purpose: Behind the scrubber and bottom controls while controls show.

motion.name: tab-flip
motion.purpose: The speaking edge tab turns over like a page tab on a language switch.

motion.name: tab-reach
motion.purpose: Active edge tab stands proud of the edge.

motion.name: tab-color
motion.purpose: Fill and text colour change on language tabs.

motion.name: edge-tabs-enter-exit
motion.value: slide + fade 200ms in, 160ms out; held 1.4s after a switch

motion.name: subtitle-crossfade
motion.purpose: Subtitle text when the language changes.

motion.name: subtitle-lift
motion.purpose: Subtitle clears the control bar while controls show.

components.name: Primary Pill
components.description: Inverted white pill with black text; the one main action (Play / Resume on the setup sheet).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 320px; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; font-feature-settings: 'tnum'; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E0E0E0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #B4B4B4; }

components.name: Tonal Add Button
components.description: Raised-grey pill with white text; adds a subtitle to an empty slot.
components.css: .ds-btn-tonal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 40px; padding: 0 24px 0 16px; background: #2A2A2A; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-tonal:hover { background: #333333; } .ds-btn-tonal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Edge Index Tabs
components.description: Signature: one tab per loaded language on the picture's right edge; the speaking tab inverted and flush, the idle one pulled in.
components.css: .ds-edge { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 6px; padding: 24px 0; background: linear-gradient(#3a3532, #1a1614); width: 120px; } .ds-edge-tab { width: 52px; height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding-right: 4px; box-sizing: border-box; margin-right: -10px; border-radius: 10px 0 0 10px; background: #2A2A2A; color: #B4B4B4; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.4px; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s, margin 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-edge-tab:hover { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-edge-tab--active { margin-right: 0; background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; animation: ds-flip 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } @keyframes ds-flip { from { transform: perspective(400px) rotateX(90deg); } to { transform: perspective(400px) rotateX(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-edge-tab { transition: none; } .ds-edge-tab--active { animation: none; } }

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: Signature: the two language tabs side by side in the control bar; the visible equivalent of double-tap.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(17,17,17,0.8); } .ds-switch-tab { width: 52px; height: 42px; border: none; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #B4B4B4; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s, color 0.18s; } .ds-switch-tab:hover { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-switch-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-switch-tab--active { background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; } .ds-switch-tab--active:hover { color: #000000; }

components.name: Slot Mark
components.description: Small static language tab in library and slot rows; filled white when that language is speaking.
components.css: .ds-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 5px; background: #2A2A2A; color: #B4B4B4; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.4px; } .ds-mark--filled { background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; }

components.name: Library Row
components.description: Flat row on black: 8px-cornered 16:9 thumbnail with the blue watched bar, title, tabular metadata, language marks; no divider, separated by 14dp vertical padding.
components.html:
Kış Uykusu
3:16:00 · 34% watched
TREN
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 4px 14px 16px; background: #000000; width: 420px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:hover { background: #111111; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-thumb { position: relative; width: 128px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: #1C1C1C; flex: none; } .ds-thumb-bar { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 3px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .ds-thumb-fill { width: 34%; height: 100%; background: #3EA6FF; } .ds-row-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-row-title { color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 24px; letter-spacing: -0.1px; } .ds-row-meta { color: #B4B4B4; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-feature-settings: 'tnum'; } .ds-row-marks { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-mark { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 5px; background: #2A2A2A; color: #B4B4B4; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.4px; } .ds-mark--filled { background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; }

components.name: Seek Readout
components.description: Translucent dark panel over the picture during drag-to-seek: signed delta over position / duration, tabular.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(17,17,17,0.88); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-feature-settings: 'tnum'; } .ds-readout-delta { color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 36px; letter-spacing: -0.5px; } .ds-readout-pos { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }

components.name: Subtitle Line
components.description: White semibold Inter caption with a black stroke and soft shadow, centred low over the picture.
components.html: Bunu sana daha önce de söylemiştim.
components.css: .ds-sub-stage { padding: 32px; background: linear-gradient(#6a5a4f, #1a1614); text-align: center; } .ds-sub { margin: 0; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.9), 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.9), 0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }

narrative.overview:
Looplayer's ground is the black that surrounds a picture in a dark room. Nothing on screen competes with the video: surfaces rise out of the black by lightness alone, chrome is white glyphs over a gradient scrim, and a single hue (progress blue) is spent only on how far you are into something. The signature is a thumb index on the picture's edge: one tab per loaded subtitle language, the speaking one inverted to white and standing proud of the edge, flipping over like a page tab when a double-tap changes language.

The system is dark-only by decision. There is no light scheme and none should be added: the app is a cinema surface, and the theme (`LooplayerTheme`) wires only a `darkColorScheme`, with the window background also #000. Density is calm: generous row heights, one action per region, and controls that appear when asked for and leave after 3 s.

Type is Inter throughout, bundled with the app (Inter 4.1, SIL Open Font License 1.1; files `app/src/main/res/font/inter_{regular,medium,semibold,bold}.ttf`, license text at `app/src/main/assets/licenses/Inter-OFL.txt`). It was chosen for a professional, streaming-platform feel, full Turkish coverage and tabular figures. Dimensions in this file are dp and type sizes sp, written as px for portability.
keyCharacteristics: True-black ground (#000) with tonal steps for surfaces; no borders, no divider lines, no drop shadows at rest.
The primary action is an inverted white pill with black text.
One hue, progress blue, reserved for watched progress.
Language marks are inverted-white when speaking, muted on a dark step when not, in every context (edge tabs, control-bar switch, list marks).
Inter everywhere, semibold for titles, tracking at zero or tightened, tabular figures on every time readout.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Progress blue is spent only on how far into a video you are. Selection, focus and emphasis are expressed by inversion to white, never by colour.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: "Active" or "primary" means a white fill with black text. The speaking language, the main action, and the filled slot mark all use it; nothing else does.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock Rule
rules.body: Every time, duration, percentage, offset or line count uses tabular figures (`tnum`) so digits do not jitter while playing.

rules.name: The Zero Tracking Rule
rules.body: Titles and headlines tighten (−0.1 to −0.5px); body and labels sit at zero. Only the language index codes are spaced (+0.4px). Material's default positive tracking does not return.

rules.name: The Lightness Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface that needs to sit above another gets a lighter grey step or a translucent dark panel, never a drop shadow or a border. Lists separate items by space, not lines.

dos: Do keep the app dark-only: ground #000, surfaces as lighter greys, no light scheme.
Do mark the active or primary thing by inverting to a white fill with black text.
Do keep progress blue (#3EA6FF) on watched progress only.
Do use Inter from the bundled font files, and carry the Inter OFL license with any build that ships them.
Do set every time, duration, count and offset in tabular figures.
Do give every gesture a visible control (the language switch, ±10 s buttons) with a content description and a 48dp target.
Do keep subtitles white with the black stroke and soft shadow.
Do respect Remove animations: the tab flip, slides and fades must resolve instantly when animations are off.
donts: Don't put drop shadows, outlines or divider lines on surfaces at rest; use a lighter grey step, a translucent dark panel, or spacing.
Don't introduce a second accent hue, or colour-code the two subtitle languages; slots differ by position and inversion, not by ink.
Don't make an overlay on the picture brighter than the picture's chrome; notices sit on 88% dark panels.
Don't restore Material's default positive letter-spacing on body and labels.
Don't substitute a system or downloadable font for the bundled Inter.
